name: job_agent_pipeline
_comment_dag: Task 1 (reachability_probe) is deprecated and does nothing. Tasks 2-4 form a sequential chain (ingest_listings -> enrich_listings -> sync_vector_index). Task 5 (run_evaluation) has no depends_on and is intentionally NOT part of the automatic dependency chain: it is meant to be triggered on demand (e.g. `databricks jobs run-now --job-id <id> --only run_evaluation`) ahead of promoting a new matching_agent version, per the deployment gate in Requirement 9.5-9.6. This job declares exactly 5 tasks total, satisfying the Free Edition <=5 concurrent job tasks limit (Requirement 11.6) trivially since the dependency chain (Tasks 2-4) plus the independent Task 5 never exceeds 5 tasks running at once.
_comment_compute: No `job_clusters` and no `new_cluster`/`existing_cluster_id` on any task: every task runs on serverless compute by omitting cluster fields entirely, which is the Jobs API convention for serverless notebook tasks (Requirement 11.1).
_comment_warehouse: Tasks 3 and 5 pass `warehouse_id` as a base_parameter so their notebooks (03_enrich_listings.py's ai_query path and 05_run_evaluation.py's draft_application check) can reach the single Free Edition 2X-Small SQL warehouse referenced by the `{{job.parameters.warehouse_id}}` job-level parameter (Requirement 11.7).

tasks._comment: No depends_on: independent of Tasks 1-4. Intended for manual/on-demand runs (e.g. before promoting a new matching_agent version), not part of the automatic Tasks 1-4 trigger chain.
